classes.name: AirportCdmPartner
classes.definition: A generalization of any party participating in the Airport CDM process that originates or receives flight information and is informed by milestone procedures.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline or operator that submits the ATC Flight Plan, provides TOBT and turn-round estimates, and manages the aircraft's turn-round.

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The party that performs ground handling operations and, with the Aircraft Operator, provides turn-round times such as TOBT, ACGT and ARDT.

classes.name: AirTrafficControl
classes.definition: The air traffic control units (Area Control Centre, Approach Control, Tower) that manage flight plans, sequencing and start-up approvals.

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management function that issues CTOT, monitors flight progress via ETFMS, and is informed of updated estimates through DPI messages.

classes.name: FlightCrew
classes.definition: The pilot and aircrew who request and receive start-up approval and coordinate readiness with the Ground Handler.

classes.name: StandGateManagement
classes.definition: The stakeholder responsible for stand and gate allocation decisions that depend on accurate ELDT and EOBT sharing.

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: A single scheduled arriving or departing movement of an aircraft, carrying its operational status and the time quantities that describe its progress.

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The linked pair of an arriving and a departing flight of the same aircraft at an airport, over which the turn-round period is defined and analysed.

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The physical aircraft performing a flight, identified by type and registration, which may be updated from the ATC Flight Plan.

classes.name: AtcFlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO flight plan, including repetitive flight plans, submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by the IFPS to ATC units.

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot allocated under the airport slot programme against which the ATC Flight Plan and flight data are checked for consistency.

classes.name: AirportFlightData
classes.definition: The locally held airport data describing a flight that must be consistent with the ATC Flight Plan and Airport Slot before the first E-DPI is sent.

classes.name: TimeQuantity
classes.definition: An abstract time value describing a flight's progress, recorded with its prefix, originator and time of update, with every successive value kept rather than overwritten.

classes.name: OffBlockTime
classes.definition: The scheduled, target or actual value of the off-block event (EOBT, TOBT, AOBT) for a flight.

classes.name: InBlockTime
classes.definition: The estimated or actual value of the in-block event (EIBT, AIBT) for an arriving flight.

classes.name: LandingTime
classes.definition: The estimated or actual value of the landing event (ELDT, ALDT) for an arriving flight.

classes.name: TakeOffTime
classes.definition: The estimated, target, calculated or actual value of the take-off event (ETOT, TTOT, CTOT, ATOT) for a departing flight.

classes.name: StartUpApprovalTime
classes.definition: The target or actual value of the start-up approval event (TSAT, ASAT) for a departing flight.

classes.name: StartBoardingTime
classes.definition: The actual time at which boarding of a flight starts (ASBT).

classes.name: ReadyTime
classes.definition: The actual time at which an aircraft is ready for start-up and push-back (ARDT).

classes.name: StartUpRequestTime
classes.definition: The actual time at which start-up is requested by the flight crew (ASRT).

classes.name: DurationEstimate
classes.definition: A duration used to calculate other time quantities, such as estimated taxi-out time (EXOT), estimated taxi-in time (EXIT), minimum turn-round time (MTTT) or estimated turn-round time (ETTT).

classes.name: Milestone
classes.definition: An abstract representation of one of the sixteen defined events in the CDM process, each with its own trigger, timing rule, effect and procedure.

classes.name: AtcFlightPlanActivation
classes.definition: The milestone at which the ATC Flight Plan is submitted and the Airport CDM Platform is initiated for the flight.

classes.name: EobtMinusTwoHourCheck
classes.definition: The milestone at EOBT-2 hours at which regulated flights receive a CTOT and Network Operations is informed by the first T-DPI message.

classes.name: TakeOffFromOutstation
classes.definition: The milestone at which ATOT from the outstation is received and used to update ELDT and, when needed, inform Network Operations via a T-DPI-t message.

classes.name: LocalRadarUpdate
classes.definition: The milestone at which the flight is detected entering the FIR or local airspace, triggering a TOBT process and ELDT/EIBT update.

classes.name: FinalApproach
classes.definition: The milestone at which the flight enters final approach at the destination, triggering a new TOBT determination.

classes.name: Landed
classes.definition: The milestone at which ALDT is recorded, triggering updates to TOBT, TTOT and EIBT.

classes.name: InBlock
classes.definition: The milestone at which AIBT is recorded, triggering updates to TOBT and TTOT based on the estimated turn-round period.

classes.name: GroundHandlingStarted
classes.definition: The milestone at which ground handling commences (ACGT) for first-of-day or long-parked flights, triggering a TOBT update.

classes.name: FinalConfirmationOfTobt
classes.definition: The milestone at which the Aircraft Operator or Ground Handler provides their most accurate TOBT ahead of TSAT issue.

classes.name: TsatIssued
classes.definition: The milestone at which ATC issues the Target Start-Up Approval Time and checks the number of subsequent TOBT updates.

classes.name: BoardingStarts
classes.definition: The milestone at which boarding of passengers physically starts, used to check whether TOBT will be respected.

classes.name: AircraftReady
classes.definition: The milestone at which the aircraft is ready for start-up and push-back, informing partners and checking against TOBT.

classes.name: StartUpRequested
classes.definition: The milestone at which start-up is requested by the pilot, with an alert if no request is made within the TSAT tolerance window.

classes.name: StartUpApproved
classes.definition: The milestone at which ATC grants start-up approval, checked against TSAT with resequencing if not granted in time.

classes.name: OffBlock
classes.definition: The milestone at which the aircraft pushes back, recorded as AOBT and always triggering an A-DPI message to Network Operations.

classes.name: TakeOff
classes.definition: The milestone at which the aircraft takes off, recorded as ATOT, generating an airborne message and removing the flight from the departure sequence.

classes.name: AirportCdmPlatform
classes.definition: The central CDM system that is initiated for each flight, processes available information, and performs the Action on CDM Operation updates and partner notifications described at each milestone.

classes.name: AtcSystem
classes.definition: The ATC system, including Tower FDPS, that provides landing, in-block and off-block times and calculates EXOT.

classes.name: SurveillanceRadarSystem
classes.definition: The radar system (including A-SMGCS) that detects a flight by its assigned SSR code when it crosses the FIR/ATC boundary or enters final approach.

classes.name: Acars
classes.definition: The aircraft communications addressing and reporting system that provides landing, in-block, off-block and take-off times for equipped aircraft.

classes.name: AutomatedDockingSystem
classes.definition: An automated system that detects an aircraft's arrival in-block or departure off-block.

classes.name: Etfms
classes.definition: The Network Operations system that monitors a flight's progress and generates Flight Update Messages when the flight is within three hours of the destination.

classes.name: Ifps
classes.definition: The system that distributes the submitted ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units.

classes.name: FlightInformationDisplaySystem
classes.definition: The airport system, including flight information display and public address systems, used to inform partners and pre-call passengers.

classes.name: DpiMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message exchanged with Network Operations at defined milestones, distinguished by its type (E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, A-DPI).

classes.name: FlightUpdateMessage
classes.definition: The FUM message sent by Network Operations that provides updates of an inbound flight's progress.

classes.name: ReadyStatusMessage
classes.definition: The Ready Status (RDY) message confirming that a flight follows the indicated TOBT and is ready for start-up.

classes.name: StartUpRequestMessage
classes.definition: The message by which the flight crew requests start-up, made by voice or DCL.

classes.name: MovementMessage
classes.definition: A message sent on actual take-off informing partners of the flight's movement, including FSA, MVT and the airborne message.

packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.
